title: From Nodes to Pixels: Topological and Structural Two-View Graph Imaging
abstract: arXiv:2611.14750v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Graph learning still lacks a broadly reusable input interface comparable to patches in vision or tokens in language. Unlike images or text, graphs are irregular, vary in size and density, and are invariant under many equivalent node labelings, making it difficult to standardize inputs across tasks and architectures. We introduce G2Image, a fixed-budget graph imaging framework that converts each graph into two complementary image-like views. TopoGrid provides a stable topological view by encoding an intrinsic bifiltration as a compact multipersistence surface grid, while GraphGrid provides a higher-bandwidth structural view by aggregating edge densities between groups defined by intrinsic node scores. Both views are permutation-invariant and come with resolution-controlled stability guarantees. translated_title: 从节点到像素：拓扑与结构双视角图成像
translated_abstract: 图学习仍然缺乏一个像视觉中的图像块或语言中的词元那样广泛可复用的输入接口。与图像或文本不同，图是不规则的，其大小和密度各不相同，并且在许多等价的节点标记下保持不变，这使得难以在不同任务和架构之间对输入进行标准化。我们提出了 G2Image，一个固定预算的图成像框架，它将每个图转换为两个互补的类图像视图。TopoGrid 通过将内在双滤过编码为紧凑的多持续性曲面网格，提供一个稳定的拓扑视图；而 GraphGrid 通过聚合由内在节点分数定义的组之间的边密度，提供一个更高带宽的结构视图。两种视图均具有置换不变性，并带有分辨率可控的稳定性保证。由于所得表示是固定大小的张量，它们可以由轻量级的 2D 编码器处理，并通过有监督的方式对齐（原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出 G2Image 框架，将图数据转换为 TopoGrid（拓扑视图）和 GraphGrid（结构视图）两个置换不变的固定大小图像表示，为图学习提供了类似视觉图像块和语言词元的标准化输入接口。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes G2Image, a framework that converts graphs into two permutation-invariant, fixed-size image representations (TopoGrid for topology and GraphGrid for structure), providing graph learning with a standardized input interface analogous to patches in vision and tokens in language.
